prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: filled terrain material atlas for an original hand-drawn 2D side-scrolling fantasy game. A transparent landscape 3-column by 2-row atlas containing exactly six LARGE THICK SOLID GROUND AND CLIFF sections, one per equal cell. These are grounded geology and architecture, not floating stepping platforms. Each occupies about 85 percent cell width and 80 percent height, generous transparent gutters, no touching cells. Pure orthographic SIDE elevation, flat hand-painted 2D shapes, crisp fine dark ink outlines and rich layered material detail, like an illustrated metroidvania scene. All sections have a clearly readable long near-horizontal top ground edge and a deep opaque body extending below, with a dense continuous texture across the whole interior, very little empty space inside the body. Flat top surfaces seen only as edge lines, no visible 3D top planes, no receding perspective. Six different designs in reading order: (1) grassy/stone ground with compacted soil strata; (2) dense broad rock foundation with chipped face; (3) huge stratified cliff face and cracks; (4) tangled root bound thick earth; (5) thick worn masonry causeway body with inset arches carved in its solid face; (6) ancient shell stone floor with branching mineral seams. Each complete thick mass fits in one cell. Top edges slightly organic but nearly flat, intricate side elevation detail, outer lower edges naturally irregular. Transparent alpha background. No text, no labels, no borders, no characters, no skies, no enormous dangling ornaments, no thin floating platforms, no isometric or 3D rendering, no pixel art. Palette and dominant materials for THIS region: moss green turf, dark slate rocks, tangled ochre roots, pale lime lichen, damp teal shadows.
